title: Checkout authorization latency surge
summary: The order-submit p99 latency has crossed its SLO and client retries are increasing, while ingress volume and pod availability remain near their usual levels.
precursor: Release checkout-api v2.31 enabled a second-stage payment authorization call for orders containing split tenders; the rollout completed without changing the replica count.
impact: More shoppers abandon checkout or submit duplicate attempts, and the payment operations team sees a growing count of orders awaiting confirmation.

title: Partner identity refresh stall
summary: Partner identity refresh jobs are falling behind their hourly freshness target; worker utilization is low and the job error count is concentrated on one partner feed.
precursor: The platform team moved identity-sync pods onto a newly provisioned node pool during the overnight maintenance window; the deployment image and feed schedule were unchanged.
impact: Recently changed partner roles are not reflected promptly in access decisions, increasing support escalations for users whose permissions appear out of date.

title: Invoice event freshness regression
summary: Invoice status freshness is outside its target and the oldest-message age has stopped improving, despite normal consumer health checks and spare worker capacity.
precursor: A billing schema release introduced an optional tax adjustment field, after which one invoice event began recurring in consumer delivery telemetry during the regional peak.
impact: Customer portals continue to show stale invoice states and downstream reconciliation reports are delayed for the affected billing window.

title: Media rendition worker instability
summary: Rendition completion time is rising for high-resolution uploads, with intermittent worker losses and a widening gap between accepted and completed jobs.
precursor: A creator campaign increased the proportion of 4K source uploads, and the transcoder rollout added a new color-conversion stage to the standard rendition pipeline.
impact: New video previews become available late, reducing creator engagement and increasing the number of customer tickets about missing renditions.

title: Policy evaluation canary errors
summary: Authorization evaluation failures are elevated on the canary while the stable fleet remains healthy; requests using recently changed policies are most affected.
precursor: Policy-evaluator v5.8.0 was promoted to a small canary after the policy bundle naming convention changed in the release pipeline.
impact: Some administrative actions are temporarily denied or retried, and operators have paused further rollout while access decisions are reviewed.
